          "calledBy": [

          ],
          "body": "{\n  const allNodes: any[] = [];\n  const visited = new Set<any>();\n\n  function traverse(node: any) {\n    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object' || visited.has(node)) return;\n    visited.add(node);\n    allNodes.push(node);\n\n    // Обходим все свойства узла рекурсивно\n    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n      const value = node[key];\n      if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n        for (const item of value) {\n          if (item && typeof item === 'object') {\n            traverse(item);\n          }\n        }\n      } else if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !(value instanceof RegExp)) {\n        // Пропускаем RegExp и другие специальные объекты\n        try {\n          traverse(value);\n        } catch (e) {\n          // Игнорируем ошибки\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  traverse(ast);\n  return allNodes;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!ast) {\n    console.warn('⚠️ AST is null, returning original code');\n    return code;\n  }\n\n  const cuts: { start: number; end: number; replaceWith: string }[] = [];\n\n  // Собираем все узлы рекурсивно\n  const allNodes = collectAllNodes(ast);\n  console.log(`📊 Собрано узлов для обработки: ${allNodes.length}`);\n\n  for (const node of allNodes) {\n    // Замена тел функций и методов (включая FunctionExpression)\n    if (\n      (node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' ||\n        node.type === 'FunctionExpression' ||\n        node.type === 'MethodDefinition' ||\n        node.type === 'ClassMethod') &&\n      node.body &&\n      node.body.range\n    ) {\n      const bodyStart = node.body.range[0];\n      const bodyEnd = node.body.range[1];\n\n      if (bodyStart < bodyEnd && bodyEnd - bodyStart > 2) {\n        cuts.push({\n          start: bodyStart + 1,\n          end: bodyEnd - 1,\n          replaceWith: ' /* реализация скрыта */ ',\n        });\n        const nodeName = node.key?.name || node.id?.name || 'anonymous';\n        console.log(`   ✂️ Найдена функция/метод: ${nodeName}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Замена тел стрелочных функций\n    if (\n      node.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' &&\n      node.body &&\n      node.body.type === 'BlockStatement' &&\n      node.body.range\n    ) {\n      const bodyStart = node.body.range[0];\n      const bodyEnd = node.body.range[1];\n\n      if (bodyStart < bodyEnd && bodyEnd - bodyStart > 2) {\n        cuts.push({\n          start: bodyStart + 1,\n          end: bodyEnd - 1,\n          replaceWith: ' /* реализация скрыта */ ',\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Замена значений переменных\n    if (\n      node.type === 'VariableDeclarator' &&\n      node.init &&\n      !['ArrowFunctionExpression', 'FunctionExpression'].includes(node.init.type) &&\n      node.init.range\n    ) {\n      if (!shouldPreserveValue(node)) {\n        cuts.push({\n          start: node.init.range[0],\n          end: node.init.range[1],\n          replaceWith: '/* значение скрыто */',\n        });\n        console.log(`   🔒 Переменная: ${node.id?.name} → значение скрыто`);\n      } else {\n        console.log(`   ✅ Сохранена переменная: ${node.id?.name}`);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Применяем замены от конца к началу\n  cuts.sort((a, b) => b.start - a.start);\n  let minifiedCode = code;\n\n  for (const cut of cuts) {\n    minifiedCode = minifiedCode.slice(0, cut.start) + cut.replaceWith + minifiedCode.slice(cut.end);\n  }\n\n  console.log(`📊 Выполнено замен: ${cuts.length}`);\n\n  // Очистка лишних пустых строк\n  return minifiedCode.replace(/^\\s*[\\r\\n]/gm, '\\n').replace(/\\n{3,}/g, '\\n\\n');\n}",
          "startLine": 47,

          "returnType": "boolean",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [

          "body": "{\n  if (!node.init || !node.id || !node.id.name) return false;\n\n  const varName = node.id.name;\n  const initNode = node.init;\n\n  // Сохраняем конфигурационные переменные (UPPER_CASE)\n  const preservePatterns = [\n    /^[A-Z][A-Z_]+$/, // UPPER_CASE - конфигурационные константы\n    /PATTERNS$/,\n    /SELECTORS$/,\n    /CONFIG$/,\n    /SETTINGS$/,\n    /OPTIONS$/,\n    /_CONFIG$/,\n    /_SETTINGS$/,\n    /_OPTIONS$/,\n    /^pageContext$/,\n    /^lastPageState$/,\n    /^syncScheduled$/,\n  ];\n\n  for (const pattern of preservePatterns) {\n    if (pattern.test(varName)) {\n      return true;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Сохраняем регулярные выражения\n  if (initNode.type === 'RegExpLiteral') {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  // Сохраняем массивы с селекторами или паттернами\n  if (initNode.type === 'ArrayExpression' && initNode.elements) {\n    for (const element of initNode.elements) {\n      if (!element) continue;\n      if (element.type === 'RegExpLiteral') return true;\n      if (element.type === 'Literal' && typeof element.value === 'string') {\n        const strValue = element.value;\n        if (\n          strValue.startsWith('#') ||\n          strValue.startsWith('.') ||\n          strValue.startsWith('[') ||\n          strValue.includes('selector') ||\n          strValue.includes('pattern')\n        ) {\n          return true;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Сохраняем примитивные значения (строки, числа, булевы)\n  if (initNode.type === 'Literal') {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  console.log(`📄 Минификация файла: ${filePath}`);\n\n  const code = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');\n  console.log(`📏 Исходный размер: ${code.length} символов`);\n\n  const ast = parseFile(filePath);\n  if (!ast) {\n    console.error('❌ Не удалось получить AST, возвращаем оригинальный код');\n    return code;\n  }\n\n  // Проверяем, что AST содержит все тело программы\n  if (ast.body) {\n    console.log(`📊 AST содержит ${ast.body.length} узлов верхнего уровня`);\n  }\n\n  const minified = minifyCodeString(code, ast);\n  console.log(`✅ Размер после минификации: ${minified.length} символов`);\n  console.log(`📉 Сжатие: ${((1 - minified.length / code.length) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);\n\n  return minified;\n}",

    "src/core/graph-utils.ts": {
      "functions": [
        {
          "name": "findCyclicEdges",
          "line": 8,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graph"
          ],
          "returnType": "Set<string>",
          "calls": [
            "dfs"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const visited: Record<string, number> = {};\n  const cyclicEdges = new Set<string>();\n  const recursionStack = new Set<string>();\n\n  // Инициализация статусов: 0 - не посещен, 1 - в процессе, 2 - обработан\n  Object.keys(graph).forEach(node => {\n    visited[node] = 0;\n  });\n\n  function dfs(node: string, path: string[] = []): void {\n    visited[node] = 1; // В процессе обхода\n    recursionStack.add(node);\n    path.push(node);\n\n    const neighbors = graph[node] || [];\n\n    for (const neighbor of neighbors) {\n      if (recursionStack.has(neighbor)) {\n        // Найден цикл: отмечаем все ребра в цикле\n        const cycleStartIndex = path.indexOf(neighbor);\n        if (cycleStartIndex !== -1) {\n          for (let i = cycleStartIndex; i < path.length; i++) {\n            const from = path[i];\n            const to = i + 1 < path.length ? path[i + 1] : neighbor;\n            cyclicEdges.add(`${from}->${to}`);\n          }\n        }\n        cyclicEdges.add(`${node}->${neighbor}`);\n      } else if (visited[neighbor] === 0) {\n        dfs(neighbor, [...path]);\n      }\n    }\n\n    recursionStack.delete(node);\n    visited[node] = 2; // Обработан\n  }\n\n  // Запускаем DFS для всех непосещенных узлов\n  Object.keys(graph).forEach(node => {\n    if (visited[node] === 0) dfs(node, []);\n  });\n\n  return cyclicEdges;\n}",
          "startLine": 8,
          "endLine": 52,
          "isMethod": false,
          "isNested": false,
          "isArrow": false,
          "isEventHandler": false,
          "depth": 0,

        {
          "name": "convertToDOT",
          "line": 60,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphData",

          ],
          "returnType": "string",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const { rootKey, graph } = graphData;\n\n  let dot = 'digraph \"Dependency Graph\" {\\n';\n  dot += '  rankdir=LR;\\n';\n  dot += '  splines=true;\\n';\n  dot +=\n    '  node [shape=box, style=\"filled,rounded\", color=\"#4f46e5\", fontname=\"Arial\", fillcolor=\"#f3f4f6\", fontcolor=\"#1f2937\", penwidth=1];\\n';\n  dot += '  edge [color=\"#9ca3af\", arrowhead=vee, penwidth=1];\\n';\n\n  // Корневой узел выделяем звездочкой\n  dot += `  \"${rootKey}\" [fillcolor=\"#4f46e5\", fontcolor=\"#ffffff\", penwidth=2, label=\"⭐ ${rootKey}\"];\\n`;\n\n  // Добавляем все ребра\n  Object.keys(graph).forEach(node => {\n    const nodeDeps = graph[node];\n    if (nodeDeps) {\n      nodeDeps.forEach(dep => {\n        const edgeKey = `${node}->${dep}`;\n        if (cyclicEdges.has(edgeKey)) {\n          // Подсвечиваем циклические зависимости красным\n          dot += `  \"${node}\" -> \"${dep}\" [color=\"#ef4444\", penwidth=2.5, style=\"dashed\", label=\"цикл\"];\\n`;\n        } else {\n          dot += `  \"${node}\" -> \"${dep}\";\\n`;\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  dot += '}\\n';\n  return dot;\n}",

          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  // Если указан явный путь, используем его\n  if (explicitTsConfigPath) {\n    const resolvedPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), explicitTsConfigPath);\n    const normalizedPath = normalizePathForOS(resolvedPath);\n\n    if (fs.existsSync(normalizedPath)) {\n      try {\n        const content = fs.readFileSync(normalizedPath, 'utf-8');\n        console.log(`📄 Загружен tsconfig: ${normalizedPath}`);\n        cachedTsConfig = JSON.parse(content) as TsConfig;\n        cachedTsConfigDir = path.dirname(normalizedPath);\n        return cachedTsConfig;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(`⚠️ Ошибка парсинга ${normalizedPath}:`, error);\n      }\n    } else {\n      console.warn(`⚠️ Файл tsconfig не найден: ${normalizedPath}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Иначе ищем автоматически\n  let currentDir = startDir;\n  const root = path.parse(currentDir).root;\n\n  while (currentDir !== root) {\n    const tsConfigPath = path.join(currentDir, 'tsconfig.json');\n    const normalizedTsConfigPath = normalizePathForOS(tsConfigPath);\n\n    if (fs.existsSync(normalizedTsConfigPath)) {\n      try {\n        const content = fs.readFileSync(normalizedTsConfigPath, 'utf-8');\n        cachedTsConfig = JSON.parse(content) as TsConfig;\n        cachedTsConfigDir = path.dirname(normalizedTsConfigPath);\n        console.log(`📄 Автоматически загружен tsconfig: ${normalizedTsConfigPath}`);\n        return cachedTsConfig;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(`⚠️ Ошибка парсинга ${normalizedTsConfigPath}:`, error);\n      }\n    }\n    currentDir = path.dirname(currentDir);\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}",

        {
          "name": "resolveAliasPath",
          "line": 109,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [

            "tsConfig"
          ],
          "returnType": "string | null",
          "calls": [
            "normalizePathForOS"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  if (!tsConfig?.compilerOptions?.paths) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  const { paths, baseUrl = '.' } = tsConfig.compilerOptions;\n  const baseUrlPath = path.resolve(baseDir, baseUrl);\n\n  for (const [alias, targets] of Object.entries(paths)) {\n    if (!targets || targets.length === 0) continue;\n\n    // Преобразуем паттерн алиаса в регулярное выражение\n    const escapedAlias = alias.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, '\\\\$&');\n    const pattern = escapedAlias.replace(/\\\\\\*/g, '(.*)');\n    const regex = new RegExp(`^${pattern}$`);\n    const match = importPath.match(regex);\n\n    if (match) {\n      // Берём первый целевой путь\n      let targetPath = targets[0];\n      if (!targetPath) continue;\n\n      // Заменяем * на захваченные группы\n      for (let i = 1; i < match.length; i++) {\n        const replacement = match[i];\n        if (replacement !== undefined) {\n          targetPath = targetPath.replace('*', replacement);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Резолвим относительно baseUrl\n      const resolvedPath = path.resolve(baseUrlPath, targetPath);\n      const normalizedResolvedPath = normalizePathForOS(resolvedPath);\n\n      // Проверяем существование файла с разными расширениями\n      const extensions = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.vue', '.mjs', '.cjs', ''];\n      for (const ext of extensions) {\n        const testPath = normalizedResolvedPath + ext;\n        if (fs.existsSync(testPath) && fs.statSync(testPath).isFile()) {\n          return testPath;\n        }\n        // Проверка на index файл\n        const indexPath = path.join(normalizedResolvedPath, `index${ext}`);\n        if (ext && fs.existsSync(indexPath) && fs.statSync(indexPath).isFile()) {\n          return normalizePathForOS(indexPath);\n        }\n      }\n\n      return normalizedResolvedPath;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}",

Специальная проверка: .js → .ts (и наоборот)\n  if (targetPath.endsWith('.js')) {\n    const tsPath = fullPath.replace(/\\.js$/, '.ts');\n    if (fs.existsSync(tsPath) && fs.statSync(tsPath).isFile()) {\n      console.log(`   🔄 .js → .ts: ${targetPath} → ${path.relative(process.cwd(), tsPath)}`);\n      return tsPath;\n    }\n  }\n  if (targetPath.endsWith('.ts')) {\n    const jsPath = fullPath.replace(/\\.ts$/, '.js');\n    if (fs.existsSync(jsPath) && fs.statSync(jsPath).isFile()) {\n      console.log(`   🔄 .ts → .js: ${targetPath} → ${path.relative(process.cwd(), jsPath)}`);\n      return jsPath;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 8. Проверяем ВСЕ возможные расширения (ВКЛЮЧАЯ то, что уже проверяли)\n  const extensions = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs', ''];\n\n  for (const ext of extensions) {\n    // ✅ Убрана проверка: if (ext === targetExt) continue;\n    // Теперь проверяем ВСЕ варианты, даже если они совпадают с исходным расширением\n    const testPath = fullPath + ext;\n    if (fs.existsSync(testPath) && fs.statSync(testPath).isFile()) {\n      console.log(`   📄 Найден: ${targetPath} → ${path.relative(process.cwd(), testPath)}`);\n      return testPath;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 9. Проверяем как директорию с index файлом\n  if (fs.existsSync(fullPath) && fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory()) {\n    for (const ext of extensions) {\n      const indexPath = path.join(fullPath, `index${ext}`);\n      if (fs.existsSync(indexPath) && fs.statSync(indexPath).isFile()) {\n        console.log(`   📁 Директория → index${ext}: ${targetPath}`);\n        return indexPath;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 10. Проверяем относительно tsconfig директории\n  if (tsConfigDir && tsConfigDir !== baseDir) {\n    const fromRootPath = path.resolve(tsConfigDir, targetPath);\n\n    // Проверяем файл как есть\n    if (fs.existsSync(fromRootPath) && fs.statSync(fromRootPath).isFile()) {\n      return fromRootPath;\n    }\n\n    // Проверяем без расширения\n    if (!hasExtension && fs.existsSync(fromRootPath) && fs.statSync(fromRootPath).isFile()) {\n      return fromRootPath;\n    }\n\n    // .js → .ts\n    if (targetPath.endsWith('.js')) {\n      const tsFromRoot = fromRootPath.replace(/\\.js$/, '.ts');\n      if (fs.existsSync(tsFromRoot) && fs.statSync(tsFromRoot).isFile()) {\n        return tsFromRoot;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // .ts → .js\n    if (targetPath.endsWith('.ts')) {\n      const jsFromRoot = fromRootPath.replace(/\\.ts$/, '.js');\n      if (fs.existsSync(jsFromRoot) && fs.statSync(jsFromRoot).isFile()) {\n        return jsFromRoot;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Проверяем все расширения\n    for (const ext of extensions) {\n      const testPath = fromRootPath + ext;\n      if (fs.existsSync(testPath) && fs.statSync(testPath).isFile()) {\n        return testPath;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Проверяем index файлы\n    if (fs.existsSync(fromRootPath) && fs.statSync(fromRootPath).isDirectory()) {\n      for (const ext of extensions) {\n        const indexPath = path.join(fromRootPath, `index${ext}`);\n        if (fs.existsSync(indexPath) && fs.statSync(indexPath).isFile()) {\n          return indexPath;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  try {\n    const resolvedDir = path.isAbsolute(dir) ? dir : path.resolve(process.cwd(), dir);\n    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedDir)) {\n      console.warn(`⚠️ Директория не найдена: ${resolvedDir}`);\n      return filesList;\n    }\n\n    const files = fs.readdirSync(resolvedDir);\n    for (const file of files) {\n      const name = path.join(resolvedDir, file);\n      if (excludePatterns.some(p => name.includes(p))) continue;\n      if (fs.statSync(name).isDirectory()) {\n        getAllProjectFiles(name, filesList, excludePatterns);\n      } else if (SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS.includes(path.extname(name))) {\n        filesList.push(name);\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn(\n      `⚠️ Ошибка чтения ${dir}:`,\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n    );\n  }\n  return filesList;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const functions: any[] = [];\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return functions;\n\n  walk(ast, {\n    enter(node: any, parent: any) {\n      if ((node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' || node.type === 'FunctionExpression') && node.id) {\n        const isExported = isNodeExported(node, parent);\n        functions.push({\n          name: node.id.name,\n          line: node.loc?.start?.line || 1,\n          isAsync: node.async || false,\n          isExported,\n          params: node.params.map((p: any) => {\n            if (p.type === 'Identifier') return p.name || 'unknown';\n            if (p.type === 'AssignmentPattern' && p.left) return p.left.name || 'unknown';\n            return 'unknown';\n          }),\n          returnType: node.returnType?.typeName?.name || node.returnType?.name || undefined,\n          startLine: node.loc?.start?.line || 1,\n          endLine: node.loc?.end?.line || 1,\n          body: node.body ? node.body.type : undefined,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Методы классов\n      if (node.type === 'MethodDefinition' && node.key) {\n        const methodName = node.key.name;\n        const className = parent?.id?.name || 'Anonymous';\n\n        if (methodName) {\n          const isExported = isNodeExported(node, parent);\n          functions.push({\n            name: methodName,\n            line: node.loc?.start?.line || 1,\n            isAsync: node.value?.async || false,\n            isExported,\n            params:\n              node.value?.params?.map((p: any) => {\n                if (p.type === 'Identifier') return p.name || 'unknown';\n                return 'unknown';\n              }) || [],\n            returnType: node.value?.returnType?.typeName?.name || undefined,\n            startLine: node.loc?.start?.line || 1,\n            endLine: node.loc?.end?.line || 1,\n            isMethod: true,\n            className,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    },\n  });\n\n  return functions;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const classes: any[] = [];\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return classes;\n\n  walk(ast, {\n    enter(node: any, parent: any) {\n      if (node.type === 'ClassDeclaration' && node.id) {\n        const name = node.id.name;\n        const isExported = isNodeExported(node, parent);\n\n        const methods: string[] = [];\n        const properties: string[] = [];\n\n        if (node.body?.body) {\n          for (const member of node.body.body) {\n            if (member.type === 'MethodDefinition' && member.key) {\n              methods.push(member.key.name);\n            }\n            if (member.type === 'PropertyDefinition' && member.key) {\n              properties.push(member.key.name);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        classes.push({\n          name,\n          line: node.loc?.start?.line || 1,\n          isExported,\n          methods,\n          properties,\n          extends: node.superClass?.name || undefined,\n          implements: node.implements?.map((i: any) => i.name) || [],\n          startLine: node.loc?.start?.line || 1,\n          endLine: node.loc?.end?.line || 1,\n        });\n      }\n    },\n  });\n\n  return classes;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!node) return false;\n\n  // Прямой export\n  if (node.type === 'ExportNamedDeclaration' || node.type === 'ExportDefaultDeclaration') {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  // Проверка родителя\n  if (parent) {\n    if (parent.type === 'ExportNamedDeclaration' || parent.type === 'ExportDefaultDeclaration') {\n      return true;\n    }\n    if (parent.type === 'VariableDeclaration' && isNodeExported(parent, parent.parent)) {\n      return true;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Проверка декораторов\n  if (node.decorators) {\n    for (const decorator of node.decorators) {\n      if (decorator.expression?.name === 'export') {\n        return true;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!node) return undefined;\n\n  if (node.type === 'Literal') {\n    return node.value;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'Identifier') {\n    return node.name;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'UnaryExpression') {\n    return `${node.operator}${extractValueFromNode(node.argument)}`;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'BinaryExpression') {\n    return `${extractValueFromNode(node.left)} ${node.operator} ${extractValueFromNode(node.right)}`;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ArrayExpression') {\n    return node.elements\n      .map((e: any) => extractValueFromNode(e))\n      .filter((v: any) => v !== undefined);\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ObjectExpression') {\n    const obj: Record<string, any> = {};\n    for (const prop of node.properties) {\n      if (prop.type === 'Property' && prop.key) {\n        const key = prop.key.name || prop.key.value;\n        obj[key] = extractValueFromNode(prop.value);\n      }\n    }\n    return obj;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' || node.type === 'FunctionExpression') {\n    return '[Function]';\n  }\n\n  return undefined;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!node) return false;\n\n  if (node.type === 'CallExpression' && node.callee) {\n    const callee = node.callee;\n    if (callee.type === 'Identifier') {\n      const name = callee.name;\n      if (\n        ['addEventListener', 'on', 'once', 'emit', 'dispatchEvent', 'addListener'].includes(name)\n      ) {\n        return true;\n      }\n    }\n    if (callee.type === 'MemberExpression' && callee.property) {\n      const propName = callee.property.name || callee.property.value;\n      if (\n        ['addEventListener', 'on', 'once', 'emit', 'dispatchEvent', 'addListener'].includes(\n          propName\n        )\n      ) {\n        return true;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'JSXAttribute' && node.name) {\n    const attrName = node.name.name || node.name.value;\n    if (typeof attrName === 'string' && attrName.startsWith('on')) {\n      return true;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!node) return undefined;\n\n  if (node.type === 'Literal') {\n    return node.value;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'Identifier') {\n    return node.name;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'UnaryExpression') {\n    return `${node.operator}${extractValue(node.argument)}`;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'BinaryExpression') {\n    return `${extractValue(node.left)} ${node.operator} ${extractValue(node.right)}`;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ArrayExpression') {\n    if (isArraySafe(node.elements)) {\n      return node.elements.map((e: any) => extractValue(e)).filter((v: any) => v !== undefined);\n    }\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ObjectExpression') {\n    const obj: Record<string, any> = {};\n    if (isArraySafe(node.properties)) {\n      for (const prop of node.properties) {\n        if (prop.type === 'Property' && prop.key) {\n          const key = prop.key.name || prop.key.value;\n          if (key !== undefined) {\n            obj[key] = extractValue(prop.value);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return obj;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' || node.type === 'FunctionExpression') {\n    return '[Function]';\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'TemplateLiteral') {\n    if (isArraySafe(node.quasis)) {\n      return node.quasis.map((q: any) => q.value?.raw || '').join('');\n    }\n    return '';\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'NewExpression') {\n    return `new ${node.callee?.name || '...'}()`;\n  }\n\n  return undefined;\n}",

 // ✅ НОВОЕ: используем collectDeclaredFunctions для поиска пропущенных функций\n    const declaredFunctions = collectDeclaredFunctions(ast);\n    for (const funcName of declaredFunctions) {\n      if findFunction(ast);\n\n        if (found) {\n          console.log(`   🔍 Найдена пропущенная функция: ${funcName}`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn(`⚠️ Ошибка при           "body": "{\n  const { maxDepth = 5, excludePatterns = DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS } = options;\n\n  // Проверка на исключение\n  for (const pattern of excludePatterns) {\n    if (filePath.includes(pattern)) {\n      console.log(`⏭️ Пропуск файла по паттерну: ${pattern}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  const ast = parseFile(filePath);\n  if (!ast) return null;\n\n  const code = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');\n  const lines = code.split('\\n');\n\n  const exports: any[] = [];\n  const imports: any[] = [];\n  const functions: any[] = [];\n  const classes: any[] = [];\n  const constants: any[] = [];\n  const interfaces: any[] = [];\n  const types: any[] = [];\n  const callGraph: Record<string, string[]> = {};\n  let currentFunction: string | null = null;\n  let currentDepth = 0;\n\n  walk(ast, {\n    enter(node: any) {\n      // Сбор импортов\n      if (node.type === 'ImportDeclaration' && node.source) {\n        const specifiers = node.specifiers.map((spec: any) => ({\n          local: spec.local.name,\n          imported:\n            spec.type === 'ImportSpecifier'\n              ? spec.imported.name\n              : spec.type === 'ImportDefaultSpecifier'\n                ? 'default'\n                : '*',\n          type: spec.type,\n        }));\n        imports.push({\n          source: node.source.value,\n          specifiers,\n          loc: node.loc,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Сбор экспортов\n      if (node.type === 'ExportNamedDeclaration' && node.declaration) {\n        const decl = node.declaration;\n        if (decl.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' && decl.id) {\n          exports.push({\n            name: decl.id.name,\n            type: 'function',\n            loc: decl.loc,\n            params: decl.params.map((p: any) => p.name || 'unknown'),\n            async: decl.async || false,\n            startLine: decl.loc.start.line,\n            endLine: decl.loc.end.line,\n          });\n        } else if (decl.type === 'ClassDeclaration' && decl.id) {\n          exports.push({\n            name: decl.id.name,\n            type: 'class',\n            loc: decl.loc,\n            startLine: decl.loc.start.line,\n            endLine: decl.loc.end.line,\n          });\n        } else if (decl.type === 'VariableDeclaration') {\n          decl.declarations.forEach((declarator: any) => {\n            if (declarator.id && declarator.id.name) {\n              exports.push({\n                name: declarator.id.name,\n                type: 'constant',\n                loc: declarator.loc,\n                startLine: declarator.loc.start.line,\n                endLine: declarator.loc.end.line,\n              });\n            }\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (node.type === 'ExportDefaultDeclaration' && node.declaration) {\n        const name = node.declaration.id?.name || 'default';\n        exports.push({\n          name: `default${name !== 'default' ? ` as ${name}` : ''}`,\n          type:\n            node.declaration.type === 'FunctionDeclaration'\n              ? 'function'\n              : node.declaration.type === 'ClassDeclaration'\n                ? 'class'\n                : 'value',\n          isDefault: true,\n          loc: node.loc,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Сбор функций\n      if ((node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' || node.type === 'FunctionExpression') && node.id) {\n        functions.push({\n          name: node.id.name,\n          type: 'function',\n          exported: exports.some((e: any) => e.name === node.id.name),\n          loc: node.loc,\n          params: node.params.map((p: any) => p.name || 'unknown'),\n          async: node.async || false,\n          startLine: node.loc.start.line,\n          endLine: node.loc.end.line,\n        });\n        currentFunction = node.id.name;\n        currentDepth = 0;\n        if (currentFunction) {\n          callGraph[currentFunction] = [];\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Сбор классов\n      if (node.type === 'ClassDeclaration' && node.id) {\n        classes.push({\n          name: node.id.name,\n          exported: exports.some((e: any) => e.name === node.id.name),\n          loc: node.loc,\n          methods: [],\n          startLine: node.loc.start.line,\n          endLine: node.loc.end.line,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Сбор методов классов\n      if (node.type === 'MethodDefinition' && node.key && node.parent?.parent?.id) {\n        const className = node.parent.parent.id.name;\n        const methodName = node.key.name;\n        const classObj = classes.find((c: any) => c.name === className);\n        if (classObj) {\n          classObj.methods.push({\n            name: methodName,\n            kind: node.kind,\n            static: node.static || false,\n            loc: node.loc,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Сбор констант\n      if (\n        node.type === 'VariableDeclaration' &&\n        node.parent?.type === 'Program' &&\n        !node.declarations.some((d: any) => exports.some((e: any) => e.name === d.id?.name))\n      ) {\n        node.declarations.forEach((decl: any) => {\n          if (decl.id && decl.id.name) {\n            constants.push({\n              name: decl.id.name,\n              type: 'constant',\n              loc: decl.loc,\n              startLine: 'TSTypeAliasDeclaration' && node.id) {\n        types.push({\n          name: node.id.name,\n          exported: exports.some((e: any) => e.name === node.id.name),\n          loc: node.loc,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Анализ вызовов с ограничением глубины\n      if (\n        currentFunction &&\n        node.type === 'CallExpression' &&\n        node.callee.type === 'Identifier' &&\n        currentDepth < maxDepth\n      ) {\n        const calledFunction = node.callee.name;\n        const currentCalls = callGraph[currentFunction];\n        if (currentCalls && 100 : 0) + (callFrequency[a.name] || 0);\n    const bScore = (b.exported ? 100 : 0) + (callFrequency[b.name] || 0);\n    return bScore - aScore;\n  });\n\n  for (const func of sortedFunctions) {\n    if (processed.has(func.name)) continue;\n\n    const cluster: {\n      name: string;\n      functions: string[];\n      isExported: boolean;\n      dependencies: string[];\n      importers: string[];\n      cohesionScore: number;\n      type?: 'core' | 'helper';\n      size?: number;\n      recommendation?: string;\n    } = {\n      name: `${func.name}Cluster`,\n      functions: [func.name],\n      isExported: func.exported,\n      dependencies: [...(callGraph[func.name] || [])],\n      importers: [],\n      cohesionScore: 0,\n    };\n\n    // BFS для сбора связанных функций\n    const queue = [func.name];\n    while (queue.length > 0 && cluster.functions.length < maxClusterSize) {\n      const current = queue.shift();\n      if (!current || processed.has(current)) continue;\n      processed.add(current);\n\n      const calls = callGraph[current] || [];\n      for (const call of calls) {\n        if (!cluster.functions.includes(call) && functions.some((f: any) => f.name === call)) {\n          cluster.functions.push(call);\n          if (cluster.functions.length < maxClusterSize) {\n            queue.push(call);\n          }\n          const callDeps = callGraph[call] || [];\n          cluster.dependencies.push(...callDeps);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (cluster.functions.length > 0) {\n      // Вычисление связности\n      const internalCalls = cluster.functions.reduce((count, fn) => {\n        const calls = callGraph[fn] || [];\n        return count + calls.filter((c: string) => cluster.functions.includes(c)).length;\n      }, 0);\n      const totalPossible = cluster.functions.length * (cluster.functions.length - 1);\n      cluster.cohesionScore = totalPossible > 0 ? (internalCalls / totalPossible) * 100 : 0;\n\n      // Определение типа\n      const hasExport = cluster.functions.some((f: string) =>\n        exports.some((e: any) => e.name === f)\n      );\n      cluster.type = hasExport ? 'core' : 'helper';\n      cluster.size = cluster.functions.length;\n\n      // Рекомендация по размеру\n      if (cluster.size < targetClusterSize) {\n        cluster.recommendation = '⚠️ Слишком маленький кластер.           "body": "{\n  const imports: VueComponentAnalysis['imports'] = [];\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return imports;\n\n  try {\n    for (const node of ast.body) {\n      if (node.type === 'ImportDeclaration' && node.source) {\n        const specifiers: string[] = [];\n        let isTypeOnly = false;\n\n        const importNode = node as any;\n        if (importNode.importKind === 'type') {\n          isTypeOnly = true;\n        }\n\n        for (const spec of node.specifiers) {\n          if (spec.type === 'ImportSpecifier') {\n            const importedName =\n              spec.imported.type === 'Identifier' ? spec.imported.name : spec.imported.value;\n            const localName = spec.local.name;\n            if (importedName === localName) {\n              specifiers.push(importedName);\n            } else {\n              specifiers.push(`${importedName} as ${localName}`);\n            }\n          } else if (spec.type === 'ImportDefaultSpecifier') {\n            specifiers.push(`default as ${spec.local.name}`);\n          } else if (spec.type === 'ImportNamespaceSpecifier') {\n            specifiers.push(`* as ${spec.local.name}`);\n          }\n        }\n\n        const sourceValue = node.source.value;\n        if (typeof sourceValue === 'string') {\n          imports.push({\n            source: sourceValue,\n            specifiers,\n            isTypeOnly,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    // Игнорируем ошибки\n  }\n\n  return imports;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  let report = `# 🎯 Анализ Vue компонента: ${analysis.componentName}\\n\\n`;\n\n  report += '## 📊 Статистика\\n';\n  report += `- **Размер файла:** ${(analysis.stats.totalSize / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB\\n`;\n  report += `- **Скрипт:** ${analysis.stats.scriptLines} строк (${analysis.script.isSetup ? 'setup' : 'options API'})\\n`;\n  report += `- **Шаблон:** ${analysis.stats.templateLines} строк\\n`;\n  report += `- **Стили:** ${analysis.stats.styleCount} блоков\\n`;\n  report += `- **TypeScript:** ${analysis.script.isTS ? '✅' : '❌'}\\n\\n`;\n\n  if (analysis.props.names.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 📥 Props (${analysis.props.names.length})\\n\\n`;\n    report += '| Имя | Тип | Обязательный | По умолчанию |\\n';\n    report += '|-----|-----|--------------|--------------|\\n';\n    for (const name of analysis.props.names) {\n      const type = analysis.props.types[name] || 'any';\n      const required = analysis.props.required[name] ? '✅' : '❌';\n      const defaultValue =\n        analysis.props.defaults[name] !== undefined ? String(analysis.props.defaults[name]) : '-';\n      report += `| \\`${name}\\` | \\`${type}\\` | ${required} | ${defaultValue} |\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.emits.names.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 📤 Events (${analysis.emits.names.length})\\n\\n`;\n    for (const name of analysis.emits.names) {\n      const typeInfo = analysis.emits.types[name] ? `: \\`${analysis.emits.types[name]}\\`` : '';\n      report += `- **${name}**${typeInfo}\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.expose.length > 0) {\n    report += '## 🔓 Exposed API\\n\\n';\n    for (const name of analysis.expose) {\n      report += `- \\`${name}\\`\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.slots.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 🎭 Slots (${analysis.slots.length})\\n\\n`;\n    for (const slot of analysis.slots) {\n      report += `- \\`${slot}\\`\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.composables.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 🧩 Composables (${analysis.composables.length})\\n\\n`;\n    for (const comp of analysis.composables) {\n      report += `- \\`${comp.name}\\` → переменная \\`${comp.source}\\`\\n`;\n      if (comp.args.length > 0) {\n        report += `  - Аргументы: ${comp.args.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.imports.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 📦 Импорты (${analysis.imports.length})\\n\\n`;\n    const externalImports = analysis.imports.filter(i => !i.source.startsWith('.'));\n    const internalImports = analysis.imports.filter(i => i.source.startsWith('.'));\n\n    if (externalImports.length > 0) {\n      report += '### Внешние зависимости\\n';\n      for (const imp of externalImports) {\n        report += `- \\`${imp.source}\\` → ${imp.specifiers.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n      report += '\\n';\n    }\n\n    if (internalImports.length > 0) {\n      report += '### Локальные модули\\n';\n      for (const imp of internalImports) {\n        report += `- \\`${imp.source}\\` → ${imp.specifiers.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n      report += '\\n';\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.template.complexity > 0) {\n    report += '## 🏗️ Шаблон\\n\\n';\n    report += `- **Сложность:** ${analysis.template.complexity} элементов\\n`;\n    if (analysis.template.rootElements.length > 0) {\n      report += `- **Корневые элементы:** ${analysis.template.rootElements.join(', ')}\\n`;\n    }\n    if (analysis.template.directives.length > 0) {\n      report += `- **Директивы:** ${analysis.template.directives.join(', ')}\\n`;\n    }\n    if (analysis.template.events.length > 0) {\n      report += `- **События:** ${analysis.template.events.join(', ')}\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  report += '---\\n';\n  report += '## 💡 Рекомендации по разбиению\\n\\n';\n\n  if (analysis.template.complexity > 50) {\n    report += `⚠️ **Шаблон слишком большой** (${analysis.template.complexity} элементов). Рекомендуется вынести части в отдельные компоненты.\\n\\n`;\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.props.names.length > 10) {\n    report += `⚠️ **Много props** (${analysis.props.names.length}). Возможно, компонент пытается делать слишком много.\\n\\n`;\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.composables.length > 5) {\n    report += `⚠️ **Много composables** (${analysis.composables.length}). Рассмотрите группировку связанной логики.\\n\\n`;\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.stats.scriptLines > 300) {\n    report += `⚠️ **Скрипт слишком большой** (${analysis.stats.scriptLines} строк). Разбейте на несколько composables.\\n\\n`;\n  }\n\n  return report;\n}",

          "calls": [

          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const pipeline = new SemanticPipeline({ wasmPath: options.wasmPath });\n\n  const files: string[] = [];\n  for (const p of paths) {\n    if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\n      const stat = fs.statSync(p);\n      if (\n        stat.isFile() &&\n        (p.endsWith('.ts') || p.endsWith('.tsx') || p.endsWith('.js') || p.endsWith('.jsx'))\n      ) {\n        files.push(path.resolve(p));\n      } else if (stat.isDirectory()) {\n        const pattern = `${p}/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}`;\n        const matched = await glob(pattern, {\n          ignore: ['**/node_modules/**', '**/dist/**', '**/build/**'],\n        });\n        files.push(...matched.map(f => path.resolve(f)));\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (files.length === 0) {\n    console.error('❌ No files found to analyze');\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      metrics: {\n        totalFunctions: 0,\n        totalFiles: 0,\n        unusedFunctions: 0,\n        unusedVariables: 0,\n        potentialBugs: 0,\n        verifiedFunctions: 0,\n        cyclomaticComplexity: 0,\n        dataFlowIssues: 0,\n        typeErrors: 0,\n        cyclicDependencies: 0,\n        unreachableBlocks: 0,\n      },\n      issues: [],\n      verificationResults: [],\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      duration: 0,\n    };\n  }\n\n  return pipeline.run(files, options);\n}",

          "line": 1085,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "left",

          "returnType": "import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/src/formal/Z3Verifier\").VerificationConstraint",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  // Нормализуем оператор\n  let normalizedOp: 'eq' | 'neq' | 'gt' | 'gte' | 'lt' | 'lte';\n  switch (operator) {\n    case '<':\n      normalizedOp = 'lt';\n      break;\n    case '<=':\n      normalizedOp = 'lte';\n      break;\n    case '>':\n      normalizedOp = 'gt';\n      break;\n    case '>=':\n      normalizedOp = 'gte';\n      break;\n    default:\n      normalizedOp = operator;\n  }\n\n  // Используем нормализованный оператор\n  switch (normalizedOp) {\n    case 'eq':\n      return { type: 'equality', left, right };\n    case 'neq':\n      return { type: 'inequality', left, right };\n    case 'gt':\n      return {\n        type: 'range',\n        variable: left,\n        min: typeof right === 'number' ? right + 1 : 0,\n        max: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n      };\n    case 'gte':\n      return {\n        type: 'range',\n        variable: left,\n        min: typeof right === 'number' ? right : 0,\n        max: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n      };\n    case 'lt':\n      return {\n        type: 'range',\n        variable: left,\n        min: -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n        max: typeof right === 'number' ? right - 1 : 0,\n      };\n    case 'lte':\n      return {\n        type: 'range',\n        variable: left,\n        min: -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n        max: typeof right === 'number' ? right : 0,\n      };\n    default:\n      return { type: 'equality', left, right };\n  }\n}",
          "startLine": 1085,
          "endLine": 1146,

          "body": "{\n  const outputDir = path.dirname(outputPath);\n  const templateDir = path.join(__dirname, 'templates');\n\n  // Проверяем наличие шаблона\n  const templatePath = path.join(templateDir, 'interactive-report.template.html');\n  if (!fs.existsSync(templatePath)) {\n    console.error(`❌ Шаблон не найден: ${templatePath}`);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Создаем целевую директорию\n  if (!fs.existsSync(outputDir)) {\n    fs.mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });\n  }\n\n  console.log('\\n📋 Подготовка файлов...');\n\n  // ============================================================\n  // 1. КОПИРУЕМ data-converter.js ИЗ TEMPLATES\n  // ============================================================\n  const srcFile = path.join(templateDir, 'data-converter.js');\n  const destFile = path.join(outputDir, 'data-converter.js');\n\n  if (fs.existsSync(srcFile)) {\n    fs.copyFileSync(srcFile, destFile);\n    console.log(`  ✅ Скопирован: data-converter.js`);\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`  ⚠️ data-converter.js не найден в ${templateDir}`);\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================\n  // 2. КОПИРУЕМ interactive-report.css ИЗ TEMPLATES\n  // ============================================================\n  const cssSrc = path.join(templateDir, 'interactive-report.css');\n  const cssDest = path.join(outputDir, 'interactive-report.css');\n\n  if (fs.existsSync(cssSrc)) {\n    fs.copyFileSync(cssSrc, cssDest);\n    console.log(`  ✅ Скопирован: interactive-report.css`);\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`  ⚠️ interactive-report.css не найден в ${templateDir}`);\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================\n  // 3. КОПИРУЕМ interactive-report.js ИЗ TEMPLATES\n  // ============================================================\n  const jsSrc = path.join(templateDir, 'interactive-report.js');\n  const jsDest = path.join(outputDir, 'interactive-report.js');\n\n  if (fs.existsSync(jsSrc)) {\n    fs.copyFileSync(jsSrc, jsDest);\n    console.log(`  ✅ Скопирован: interactive-report.js`);\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`  ⚠️ interactive-report.js не найден в ${templateDir}`);\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================\n  // 4. КОПИРУЕМ ДИРЕКТОРИЮ modules (НОВОЕ!)\n  // ============================================================\n  const modulesSrc = path.join(templateDir, 'modules');\n  const modulesDest = path.join(outputDir, 'modules');\n\n  if (fs.existsSync(modulesSrc)) {\n    copyDirectory(modulesSrc, modulesDest);\n    console.log(\n      `  ✅ Скопирована директория: modules/ (${fs.readdirSync(modulesSrc).length} файлов)`\n    );\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`  ⚠️ Директория modules не найдена в ${templateDir}`);\n    console.warn('  💡 Создайте директорию modules/ с файлами:');\n    console.warn('     - CardManager.js');\n    console.warn('     - GraphManager.js');\n    console.warn('     - BreadcrumbManager.js');\n    console.warn('     - GraphModeManager.js');\n    console.warn('     - CardModeManager.js');\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================\n  // 5. ПРЕОБРАЗУЕМ ДАННЫЕ\n  // ============================================================\n  let report = DataConverter.buildReportFromAnalysis(analysis);\n\n  if (entitiesWithCalls) {\n    report = DataConverter.enrichReport(report, entitiesWithCalls);\n  }\n\n  // Собираем все функции для встраивания в JS\n  const allFunctions: { modulePath: string; func: any }[] = [];\n  for (const [modulePath, pkg] of Object.entries(report.packages)) {\n    if (!pkg) continue;\n    for (const func of pkg.entities.functions) {\n      allFunctions.push({ modulePath, func });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================\n  // 6. ВСТРАИВАЕМ ДАННЫЕ В HTML\n  // ============================================================\n  let htmlContent = fs.readFileSync(templatePath, 'utf8');\n\n  // Статические данные для подстановки\n  const staticReplacements: Record<string, string> = {\n    __STAT_MODULES__: String(report.fileStats.totalFiles),\n    __STAT_FUNCTIONS__: String(report.entityStats.totalFunctions),\n    __STAT_CALLS__: String(report.entityStats.totalCalls),\n    __STAT_EXPORTED__: String(report.entityStats.totalExportedFunctions),\n    __STAT_ASYNC__: String(report.entityStats.totalAsyncFunctions),\n    __STAT_LINES__: String(report.fileStats.totalLines),\n    __STAT_SIZE__: (report.fileStats.totalSize / 1024).toFixed(2),\n    __TYPES_BY_LANG__: 'typescript, javascript',\n    __ENTRY_NAMES__: analysis.root || 'не указана',\n    __TIMESTAMP__: new Date().toLocaleString(),\n  };\n\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(staticReplacements)) {\n    htmlContent = htmlContent.replaceAll(key, value);\n  }\n\n  // Встраиваем данные в JavaScript (перед importmap)\n  const reportJson = JSON.stringify(report);\n  const functionsJson = JSON.stringify(allFunctions);\n\n  const dataScript = `\n    <script>\n      (function() {\n        const SYM_REPORT_DATA = Symbol.for('__AST_INTERACTIVE_REPORT_DATA__');\n        const SYM_FUNCTIONS_DATA = Symbol.for('__AST_INTERACTIVE_FUNCTIONS_DATA__');\n        const SYM_DATA_VERSION = Symbol.for('__AST_INTERACTIVE_DATA_VERSION__');\n\n        globalThis[SYM_REPORT_DATA] = ${reportJson};\n        globalThis[SYM_FUNCTIONS_DATA] = ${functionsJson};\n        globalThis[SYM_DATA_VERSION] = 1;\n\n        console.log('✅ Данные загружены');\n        console.log('📊 Модулей:', Object.keys(globalThis[SYM_REPORT_DATA].packages || {}).length);\n        console.log('ƒ Функций:', globalThis[SYM_FUNCTIONS_DATA].length);\n      })();\n    </script>\n  `;\n\n  // Вставляем dataScript перед importmap\n  htmlContent = htmlContent.replace(\n    '<script type=\"importmap\">',\n    dataScript + '\\n    <script type=\"importmap\">'\n  );\n\n  // ============================================================\n  // 7. СОХРАНЯЕМ HTML\n  // ============================================================\n  fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, htmlContent, 'utf-8');\n\n  console.log(`\\n✅ Отчет сохранен: ${outputPath}`);\n  console.log(`📊 Модулей: ${report.fileStats.totalFiles}`);\n  console.log(`ƒ Функций: ${report.entityStats.totalFunctions}`);\n  console.log(`📞 Вызовов: ${report.entityStats.totalCalls}`);\n}",

          ],
          "body": "{\n  if (!filePath) return '';\n\n  let normalized = filePath;\n\n  // Если путь абсолютный и нужно сделать относительным\n  if (path.isAbsolute(normalized) && options.relative !== false) {\n    try {\n      normalized = path.relative(baseDir, normalized);\n    } catch {\n      // Если не удалось сделать относительным, оставляем как есть\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Заменяем обратные слеши на прямые (Windows → Unix)\n  normalized = normalized.replace(/\\\\/g, '/');\n\n  // Убираем избыточные точки в начале пути (если они есть)\n  // Например: \"../../../src/index.ts\" → \"src/index.ts\"\n  if (normalized.startsWith('../')) {\n    const parts = normalized.split('/');\n    const filtered = parts.filter(p => p !== '..' && p !== '.');\n    if (filtered.length > 0) {\n      const candidate = filtered.join('/');\n      if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {\n        normalized = candidate;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return normalized;\n}",

          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const normalized = normalizePathForDisplay(filePath);\n  if (normalized.length <= maxLength) return normalized;\n\n  const parts = normalized.split('/');\n  if (parts.length <= 2) return normalized;\n\n  // ✅ Упрощенная логика: берем первый и последние 2 элемента\n  // Например: /home/user/project/src/very/long/nested/directory/structure/file.ts\n  // → /home/.../directory/structure/file.ts\n  let prefix = '';\n  let startIndex = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {\n    if (parts[i] === '..' || parts[i] === '.') {\n      prefix += parts[i] + '/';\n      startIndex = i + 1;\n    } else {\n      break;\n    }\n  }\n\n  const remaining = parts.slice(startIndex);\n  if (remaining.length <= 2) return normalized;\n\n  // ✅ Используем все части напрямую\n  const first = remaining[0] || '';\n  const lastTwo = remaining.slice(-2);\n\n  // Формируем сокращенный путь\n  let result = prefix;\n  if (first) {\n    result += first + '/.../';\n  }\n  result += lastTwo.join('/');\n\n  return result;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!filePath) return false;\n\n  // Нормализуем путь\n  const normalizedPath = normalizePathForOS(filePath);\n\n  if (!fs.existsSync(normalizedPath)) return false;\n\n  // Для Windows/macOS - регистр не важен\n  if (process.platform === 'win32' || process.platform === 'darwin') {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  // Для Linux - проверяем регистр\n  const dir = path.dirname(normalizedPath);\n  const base = path.basename(normalizedPath);\n  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return false;\n\n  try {\n    const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);\n    return files.includes(base);\n  } catch {\n    return false;\n  }\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!filePath) return false;\n\n  // Проверяем длину пути (Windows ограничение 260 символов)\n  if (filePath.length > 260) return false;\n\n  // Проверяем запрещенные символы в Windows\n  const invalidChars = /[<>:\"|?*]/;\n  if (invalidChars.test(filePath)) return false;\n\n  // Проверяем зарезервированные имена\n  const reservedNames = [\n    'CON',\n    'PRN',\n    'AUX',\n    'NUL',\n    'COM1',\n    'COM2',\n    'COM3',\n    'COM4',\n    'COM5',\n    'COM6',\n    'COM7',\n    'COM8',\n    'COM9',\n    'LPT1',\n    'LPT2',\n    'LPT3',\n    'LPT4',\n    'LPT5',\n    'LPT6',\n    'LPT7',\n    'LPT8',\n    'LPT9',\n  ];\n\n  const baseName = path.basename(filePath).toUpperCase();\n  if (reservedNames.includes(baseName)) return false;\n\n  return true;\n}",

        {
          "name": "collectAllCalls",
          "line": 11,
          "isAsync": false,

          ],
          "body": "{\n  const calls: string[] = [];\n  const visited = new WeakSet<any>();\n  const includeAll = options?.includeAllIdentifiers !== false;\n  // ✅ ИСПОЛЬЗУЕМ includeLocal для фильтрации локальных вызовов\n  const includeLocal = options?.includeLocalCalls !== false;\n\n  function traverse(n: any) {\n    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;\n    if (visited.has(n)) return;\n    visited.add(n);\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 1. ПРЯМОЙ ВЫЗОВ ФУНКЦИИ: func()\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'CallExpression' && n.callee?.type === 'Identifier') {\n      const name = n.callee.name;\n      if (name && name !== currentFunction) {\n        // ✅ Проверяем, является ли функция локальной\n        const isLocal = functionNames.has(name);\n        // ✅ Если includeLocal=true, добавляем ВСЕ вызовы\n        // ✅ Если includeLocal=false, добавляем только НЕ локальные (внешние)\n        if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n          calls.push(name);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 2. ВЫЗОВ МЕТОДА: obj.method()\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'CallExpression' && n.callee?.type === 'MemberExpression') {\n      const property = n.callee.property;\n      if (property?.type === 'Identifier') {\n        const methodName = property.name;\n        if (methodName) {\n          const isLocal = functionNames.has(methodName);\n          // ✅ Добавляем только если includeLocal=true или метод не локальный\n          if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n            calls.push(methodName);\n          }\n        }\n        // ✅ ДОБАВЛЯЕМ даже если метод не объявлен (может быть извне)\n        if (includeAll && methodName) {\n          const isLocal = functionNames.has(methodName);\n          if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n            calls.push(methodName);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 3. НОВОЕ ВЫРАЖЕНИЕ: new Class()\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'NewExpression') {\n      if (n.callee?.type === 'Identifier') {\n        const name = n.callee.name;\n        if (name) {\n          const isLocal = functionNames.has(name);\n          if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n            calls.push(name);\n          }\n        }\n        if (includeAll && name) {\n          const isLocal = functionNames.has(name);\n          if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n            calls.push(name);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 4. АРГУМЕНТЫ ВЫЗОВА (вложенные вызовы)\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'CallExpression' && n.arguments) {\n      for (const arg of n.arguments) {\n        traverse(arg);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 5. RETURN STATEMENT\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ReturnStatement' && n.argument) {\n      traverse(n.argument);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 6. VARIABLE DECLARATOR\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'VariableDeclarator' && n.init) {\n      traverse(n.init);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 7. ASSIGNMENT EXPRESSION\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'AssignmentExpression' && n.right) {\n      traverse(n.right);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 8. CONDITIONAL EXPRESSION (тернарный оператор)\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ConditionalExpression') {\n      traverse(n.consequent);\n      if (n.alternate) traverse(n.alternate);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 9. IF STATEMENT\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'IfStatement') {\n      traverse(n.consequent);\n      if (n.alternate) traverse(n.alternate);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 10. LOOP STATEMENTS\n    // ============================================\n    if (['ForStatement', 'WhileStatement', 'DoWhileStatement'].includes(n.type)) {\n      if (n.body) traverse(n.body);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 11. FOR-IN / FOR-OF\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ForInStatement' || n.type === 'ForOfStatement') {\n      if (n.body) traverse(n.body);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 12. SWITCH STATEMENT\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'SwitchStatement' && n.cases) {\n      for (const caseItem of n.cases) {\n        if (caseItem.consequent) {\n          for (const consequent of caseItem.consequent) {\n            traverse(consequent);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 13. BLOCK STATEMENT\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'BlockStatement' && n.body) {\n      for (const child of n.body) {\n        traverse(child);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 14. OBJECT EXPRESSION\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ObjectExpression' && n.properties) {\n      for (const prop of n.properties) {\n        if (prop.value) traverse(prop.value);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 15. ARRAY EXPRESSION\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ArrayExpression' && n.elements) {\n      for (const elem of n.elements) {\n        traverse(elem);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 16. ARROW FUNCTION (тело)\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' && n.body) {\n      traverse(n.body);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 17. FUNCTION EXPRESSION (тело)\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'FunctionExpression' && n.body) {\n      traverse(n.body);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 18. YIELD EXPRESSION (генераторы)\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'YieldExpression' && n.argument) {\n      traverse(n.argument);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 19. AWAIT EXPRESSION\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'AwaitExpression' && n.argument) {\n      traverse(n.argument);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 20. РЕКУРСИВНЫЙ ОБХОД ВСЕХ СВОЙСТВ\n    // ============================================\n    for (const key of Object.keys(n)) {\n      const child = n[key];\n      if (child && typeof child === 'object') {\n        if (Array.isArray(child)) {\n          for (const item of child) {\n            if (item && typeof item === 'object') {\n              traverse(item);\n            }\n          }\n        } else {\n          traverse(child);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  traverse(node);\n\n  // ✅ Удаляем дубликаты и self-вызовы\n  const result = [...new Set(calls)].filter(name => name !== currentFunction);\n\n  return result;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const functions = new Set<string>();\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return functions;\n\n  function traverse(node: any) {\n    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;\n\n    // FunctionDeclaration\n    if (node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' && node.id?.name) {\n      functions.add(node.id.name);\n    }\n\n    // FunctionExpression with id\n    if (node.type === 'FunctionExpression' && node.id?.name) {\n      functions.add(node.id.name);\n    }\n\n    // VariableDeclarator with ArrowFunction/FunctionExpression\n    if (node.type === 'VariableDeclarator' && node.id?.name) {\n      if (\n        node.init &&\n        (node.init.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' || node.init.type === 'FunctionExpression')\n      ) {\n        functions.add(node.id.name);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ClassDeclaration\n    if (node.type === 'ClassDeclaration' && node.id?.name) {\n      functions.add(node.id.name);\n    }\n\n    // MethodDefinition\n    if (node.type === 'MethodDefinition' && node.key?.name) {\n      functions.add(node.key.name);\n    }\n\n    // Рекурсивный обход\n    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n      const child = node[key];\n      if (child && typeof child === 'object') {\n        if (Array.isArray(child)) {\n          for (const item of child) {\n            if (item && typeof item === 'object') {\n              traverse(item);\n            }\n          }\n        } else {\n          traverse(child);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  traverse(ast);\n  return functions;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const callers: string[] = [];\n  const declaredFunctions = collectDeclaredFunctions(ast);\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return callers;\n\n  function findFunctionNode(funcName: string): any {\n    let result: any = null;\n    let found = false;\n\n    function search(node: any) {\n      if (found) return;\n      if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;\n\n      if (node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' && node.id?.name === funcName) {\n        result = node;\n        found = true;\n        return;\n      }\n\n      if (node.type === 'VariableDeclarator' && node.id?.name === funcName) {\n        if (\n          node.init &&\n          (node.init.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' || node.init.type === 'FunctionExpression')\n        ) {\n          result = node.init;\n          found = true;\n          return;\n        }\n      }\n\n      for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n        const child = node[key];\n        if (child && typeof child === 'object') {\n          if (Array.isArray(child)) {\n            for (const item of child) {\n              if (item && typeof item === 'object') {\n                search(item);\n              }\n            }\n          } else {\n            search(child);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    search(ast);\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  // Для каждой объявленной функции проверяем, вызывает ли она targetFunction\n  for (const funcName of declaredFunctions) {\n    if (funcName === targetFunction) continue;\n\n    const funcNode = findFunctionNode(funcName);\n    if (funcNode) {\n      const calls = collectCallsFromFunction(funcNode, declaredFunctions, funcName);\n      if (calls.includes(targetFunction)) {\n        callers.push(funcName);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return callers;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const possiblePaths = [\n    // Относительно текущего файла (из dist/)\n    path.resolve(__dirname, 'wasm'),\n    // Относительно текущего файла (из src/)\n    path.resolve(__dirname, '../dist/wasm'),\n    // Относительно текущего файла (из подпапки)\n    path.resolve(__dirname, '../../dist/wasm'),\n    // В корне проекта (для монорепозиториев)\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'packages/ast-analyzer/dist/wasm'),\n    // В папке grammars проекта\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'grammars'),\n    // В node_modules (если установлен как пакет)\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'node_modules/@newkind/ast-analyzer/dist/wasm'),\n    // В корне проекта\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'wasm'),\n    // В dist проекта\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'dist/wasm'),\n  ];\n\n  for (const p of possiblePaths) {\n    if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\n      try {\n        const files = fs.readdirSync(p);\n        const hasWasm = files.some(f => f.endsWith('.wasm'));\n        if (hasWasm) {\n          console.log(`✅ WASM found at: ${p}`);\n          return p;\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        // Игнорируем ошибки чтения директории\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Если не найдено, выводим предупреждение и возвращаем путь по умолчанию\n  console.warn('⚠️ WASM directory not found. Call Graph analysis will be limited.');\n  console.warn('   Expected WASM files in one of these locations:');\n  for (const p of possiblePaths) {\n    console.warn(`     - ${p}`);\n  }\n  console.warn(\n    '   💡 Copy WASM files from packages/ast-analyzer/dist/wasm/ to one of these locations'\n  );\n\n  return path.resolve(__dirname, 'wasm');\n}",

          "params": [],

          "calls": [
            "findWasmPath"

          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const wasmPath = findWasmPath();\n  if (!fs.existsSync(wasmPath)) return [];\n\n  try {\n    return fs\n      .readdirSync(wasmPath)\n      .filter(f => f.endsWith('.wasm'))\n      .map(f => f.replace('tree-sitter-', '').replace('.wasm', ''));\n  } catch (error) {\n    return [];\n  }\n}",
          "startLine": 75,
          "endLine": 87,
          "isMethod": false,
          "isNested": false,

        {
          "name": "createWasmSymlink",
          "line": 94,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "targetPath"
          ],
          "returnType": "boolean",
          "calls": [
            "findWasmPath"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const wasmSource = findWasmPath();\n  if (!fs.existsSync(wasmSource)) {\n    console.error('❌ WASM source directory not found');\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  const target = path.resolve(process.cwd(), targetPath);\n\n  try {\n    // Удаляем существующий симлинк если есть\n    if (fs.existsSync(target)) {\n      fs.unlinkSync(target);\n    }\n\n    // Создаем симлинк\n    fs.symlinkSync(wasmSource, target, 'dir');\n    console.log(`✅ Symlink created: ${target} -> ${wasmSource}`);\n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('❌ Failed to create symlink:', error);\n    return false;\n  }\n}",
          "startLine": 94,
          "endLine": 117,
          "isMethod": false,
          "isNested": false,
          "isArrow": false,
          "isEventHandler": false,
          "depth": 0,
          "complexity": 4,
          "security": {
            "hasEval": false,
            "hasProcessEnv": false,
            "hasSensitiveData": false,
            "hasExec": false,
            "hasPassword": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "copyWasmFiles",
          "line": 124,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "targetPath"
          ],
          "returnType": "number",
          "calls": [
            "findWasmPath"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const wasmSource = findWasmPath();\n  if (!fs.existsSync(wasmSource)) {\n    console.error('❌ WASM source directory not found');\n    return 0;\n  }\n\n  const target = path.resolve(process.cwd(), targetPath);\n  if (!fs.existsSync(target)) {\n    fs.mkdirSync(target, { recursive: true });\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const files = fs.readdirSync(wasmSource).filter(f => f.endsWith('.wasm'));\n    let copied = 0;\n\n    for (const file of files) {\n      const src = path.join(wasmSource, file);\n      const dest = path.join(target, file);\n      fs.copyFileSync(src, dest);\n      copied++;\n    }\n\n    console.log(`✅ Copied ${copied} WASM files to: ${target}`);\n    return copied;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('❌ Failed to copy WASM files:', error);\n    return 0;\n  }\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const startTime = Date.now();\n\n  try {\n    const vars = new Map<string, any>();\n    for (const param of params) {\n      if (param.type === 'int') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.Int.const(param.name));\n      } else if (param.type === 'bool') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.Bool.const(param.name));\n      } else if (param.type === 'string') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.String.const(param.name));\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Создаем переменную для результата\n    let resultVar = null;\n    if (returnType !== 'void') {\n      if (returnType === 'int') {\n        resultVar = context.Int.const('result');\n      } else if (returnType === 'bool') {\n        resultVar = context.Bool.const('result');\n      } else if (returnType === 'string') {\n        resultVar = context.String.const('result');\n      }\n    }\n\n    const parser = new ExpressionParser(context);\n    const bodyExpr = parser.parse(body, vars);\n\n    if (bodyExpr && resultVar) {\n      solver.add(context.Eq(resultVar, bodyExpr));\n    }\n\n    // Добавляем предусловия\n    if (contract.preconditions) {\n      for (const pre of contract.preconditions) {\n        const constraint = parser.parse(pre, vars);\n        if (constraint) {\n          solver.add(constraint);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Добавляем постусловия\n    if (contract.postconditions) {\n      for (const post of contract.postconditions) {\n        const constraint = parser.parse(post, vars);\n        if (constraint) {\n          solver.add(constraint);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await solver.check();\n\n    if (result === 'unsat') {\n      return { isValid: true, time: Date.now() - startTime };\n    } else if (result === 'sat') {\n      const model = solver.model();\n      const counterexample = new Map<string, any>();\n      for (const [name, varExpr] of vars) {\n        try {\n          const value = model.eval(varExpr);\n          if (value) {\n            counterexample.set(name, value.toString());\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          // Игнорируем\n        }\n      }\n      return {\n        isValid: false,\n        counterexample,\n        time: Date.now() - startTime,\n      };\n    } else {\n      return {\n        isValid: false,\n        error: 'Z3 returned unknown',\n        time: Date.now() - startTime,\n      };\n    }\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    return {\n      isValid: false,\n      error: error.message || String(error),\n      time: Date.now() -           "body": "{\n  console.log('\\n🔀 ГИБРИДНЫЙ ОТЧЕТ: МОДУЛИ + ФУНКЦИИ');\n  console.log('='.repeat(70));\n  console.log(`📄 Точка входа: ${entryPoint}`);\n  console.log(`📏 Глубина: ${maxDepth}`);\n\n  const startTime = Date.now();\n\n  // 1. Строим граф зависимостей проекта\n  const projectGraph = buildProjectGraph(entryPoint, maxDepth);\n\n  // 2. Инициализируем структуры данных\n  const modules = new Map<string, HybridModule>();\n  const allNodes: HybridNode[] = [];\n  const allEdges: { from: string; to: string; type: string; level?: number }[] = [];\n  const cycles: string[][] = [];\n\n  // 3. Собираем все файлы из графа\n  const allFiles = new Set<string>();\n  allFiles.add(projectGraph.rootKey);\n\n  for (const [file, deps] of Object.entries(projectGraph.graph)) {\n    allFiles.add(file);\n    for (const dep of deps) {\n      allFiles.add(dep);\n    }\n  }\n\n  console.log(`\\n📁 Найдено модулей: ${allFiles.size}`);\n\n  // 4. Вычисляем уровни (BFS от корня)\n  const fileLevels = new Map<string, number>();\n  const queue: { file: string; level: number }[] = [{ file: projectGraph.rootKey, level: 0 }];\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n\n  while (queue.length > 0) {\n    const { file, level } = queue.shift()!;\n    if (visited.has(file)) continue;\n    visited.add(file);\n    fileLevels.set(file, level);\n\n    const deps = projectGraph.graph[file] || [];\n    for (const dep of deps) {\n      if (!visited.has(dep) && !fileLevels.has(dep)) {\n        queue.push({ file: dep, level: level + 1 });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 5. Анализируем каждый файл\n  let processed = 0;\n  for (const filePath of allFiles) {\n    const absPath = path.resolve(filePath);\n    if (!fs.existsSync(absPath)) continue;\n\n    processed++;\n    const progress = Math.round((processed / allFiles.size) * 100);\n    process.stdout.write(`\\r   🔍 Анализ: ${processed}/${allFiles.size} (${progress}%)`);\n\n    const level = fileLevels.get(filePath) ?? 0;\n    const moduleInfo = analyzeModule(absPath, level);\n\n    if (moduleInfo) {\n      modules.set(filePath, moduleInfo);\n\n      // Добавляем узел модуля\n      const moduleNode: HybridNode = {\n        id: filePath,\n        type: moduleInfo.type === 'vue' ? 'component' : 'module',\n        name: moduleInfo.name,\n        file: filePath,\n        level: level,\n        exports: moduleInfo.exports,\n        imports: moduleInfo.imports,\n        functions: moduleInfo.functions,\n        children: moduleInfo.functions.map(f => ({\n          id: `${filePath}#${f.name}`,\n          type: 'function',\n          name: f.name,\n          file: filePath,\n          line: f.line,\n          level: level,\n          calls: f.calls,\n          calledBy: f.calledBy,\n          metadata: {\n            isExported: f.isExported,\n            isAsync: f.isAsync,\n            params: f.params,\n            returnType: f.returnType,\n            exportSource: f.exportSource,\n            exportModule: f.exportModule,\n            startLine: f.startLine,\n            endLine: f.endLine,\n          },\n        })),\n        metadata: {\n          components: moduleInfo.components,\n          composables: moduleInfo.composables,\n          level: level,\n        },\n      };\n      allNodes.push(moduleNode);\n\n      // Добавляем ребра зависимостей\n      const deps = projectGraph.graph[filePath] || [];\n      for (const dep of deps) {\n        const depLevel = fileLevels.get(dep) ?? 0;\n        allEdges.push({\n          from: filePath,\n          to: dep,\n          type: 'import',\n          level: depLevel,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  console.log(' ✅');\n\n  // 6. Находим циклические зависимости\n  const cyclicEdges = findCyclicEdges(projectGraph.graph);\n  for (const edge of cyclicEdges) {\n    const [from, to] = edge.split('->');\n    if (from && to) {\n      cycles.push([from, to]);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 7. Собираем статистику по уровням\n  const byLevel: Record<number, { modules: number; functions: number }> = {};\n  let totalFunctions = 0;\n  let totalExports = 0;\n  let totalImports = 0;\n  let totalComponents = 0;\n  let totalComposables = 0;\n\n  for (const module of modules.values()) {\n    const level = module.level;\n    if (!byLevel[level]) {\n      byLevel[level] = { modules: 0, functions: 0 };\n    }\n    byLevel[level].modules++;\n    byLevel[level].functions += module.functions.length;\n\n    totalFunctions += module.functions.length;\n    totalExports += module.exports.length;\n    totalImports += module.imports.length;\n    totalComponents += module.components.length;\n    totalComposables += module.composables.length;\n  }\n\n  // 8. Формируем итоговый отчет\n  const stats = {\n    totalModules: modules.size,\n    totalFunctions,\n    totalExports,\n    totalImports,\n    totalComponents,\n    totalComposables,\n    maxDepth,\n    cycles: cycles.length,\n    byLevel,\n  };\n\n  const report: HybridReport = {\n    root: projectGraph.rootKey,\n    modules: Array.from(modules.values()),\n    graph: {\n      nodes: allNodes,\n      edges: allEdges,\n    },\n    stats,\n    cycles,\n    levels: Object.fromEntries(fileLevels),\n  };\n\n  const duration = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(2);\n  console.log(`\\n⏱️  Готово за ${duration} сек`);\n  console.log(`📊 Модулей: ${stats.totalModules}, Функций: ${stats.totalFunctions}`);\n\n  return report;\n}",
